item.title: Let the truth fuck those assholes in power
item.description: I was 21 when 9/11 happened. I was driving listening to a funny morning radio show. I was just going to a friend's house to do laundry where no one was there My friend was at work. I can't explain what I felt watching that second plane hitting. I went to New York 3 months later. I saw the crater. I saw the workers silently eating lunch on the street. Humbling doesn't describe it. I'm not a New Yorker, from the Midwest, spent most of my life in the west. But, New York has always held a special place in my heart. I fucking love NY. Best city. Best people in the world. Kind, but not nice. But they will be there for their neighbors and anyone in peril. New York is the best! Fuck Giuliani!

item.title: Fun facts about Johann Sebastian Bach.
item.description:
"Sanctus" from the "Mass in b minor." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0wNTNEZYoHg
He had the biggest organ in town.
When he broke in a new organ he would play it with all the stops pulled out for maximum loudness. He called this "testing its lungs." This is where the phrase "pull out all the stops" comes from.
Here is a hand stretching an 11th. Bach and Franz Liszt could stretch a 12th if they wanted, but neither ever wrote music requiring it, since the average man's hand can just manage a 10th. Rachmaninoff could stretch a 13th. Andre the Giant could have stretched a 16th, but his fingers were so wide he would not have been able to play just one key at a time. There is, however, no great advantage in being able to stretch a 12th. Beethoven was only 5'3.5" and could just barely manage a 9th. But he played the piano better than anyone else in the world from the time of Mozart's death until Beethoven went deaf. Beethoven never lost a piano duel.
The following fugue was improvised entirely on the spot, and then Bach wrote it down from memory afterward. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tUcMX0Pqx04
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bsh88GrsY34 If you would like to hear the entire Musical Offering, it lasts about 71 minutes and can be found below. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z4lwV3IMHMQ
This is essentially a musical palindrome, played here while visualized on a mobius strip: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xUHQ2ybTejU
The Art of the Fugue was his "exploration in depth of the contrapuntal possibilities inherent in a single musical subject." He wanted his final work to be sacred, so he composed a chorale prelude: "Before your throne I now appear, O God, and bid you humbly, turn not your gracious face from me, a poor sinner. Confer on me a blessed end. On the last day awaken me, Lord, that I may see you eternally: amen, amen, hear me."
The final page of "The Art of the Fugue." The music is in Bach's handwriting. Then he went blind. The inscription was written by Bach's son, Carl Phillip Emanuel: "At the point where the composer introduces the name BACH [for which the English notation would be B♭–A–C–B♮] in the countersubject to this fugue, the composer died."
Those pieces are: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3TlWfPS4XI0https https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3TlWfPS4XI0 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tkNzx7hXu_U

item.title: I hate the world. The man who sold me my car lied.
item.description:
I will probably just dosappear now. I have had it with being taken advantage of. As some of you know I bought a 2000 Ford Contour with 79,990 miles. Everything checked out. Clean carfax. Cold AC. No check engine light. The young man who met me from facebook said it wad his grandpa's and can't drive anymore due to health problems. I believed him. I drove slowly around his neighborhood and felt okay. Had a little jolting but car was almost on empty gas tank so I thought it was that since no check engine light. I paid the 3 grand and got it smogged. It passed. Well, it kept jolting but I was high on joy and freedom but yesterday after the gym it jolted more. Today I took it to Brake Masters. They said someone cleared the code before sale which is illegal and that's why the transmission issue and check engine light wasn't showing. They reffered me to a transmission specialist who said it could be the sensor or transmission either way could cost me up to $4500 to fix. They urged me to file a police report for fraud. They gave me the number to the original owner on file from July in their records. I messaged the number and they responded saying they sold their car to a young hispanic man for $800 and told the man it had transmission issues.
The police handed back my report saying it's a civil case. To file a lawsuit.
This was the report from July when the original owner took the car to get checked. He told me the cost for repair was too high so he sold the car September 4th to the young man who appeared on his driveway curious about the car.
This is the transmission fix estimate for my model. FUCK. They said someone cleared the censors.
These are the texts I exchanged with the original car owner. I was a bit accusatory in my upset state and that's when he responded telling me the truth that he sold it to the young man I dealt with who created a false narrative of it belonging to his sick "grandpa."
I am sorry for always encountering the wrong men who take advantage of me. I am sorry I keep believing in the good of men and people and hoping one day I will catch a break. I told this young man who sold me the car that I just left my husband, have a small savings left and can't afford repairs and he said it was all good and nothing was wrong and I believed him.
My original messages from Facebook with this "old man" and his grandson.
I feel so stupid. I was so happy about this car. I was so grateful and now I don't know what to do. The mechanic told me to come back in the morning and he will try to put a new transmission sensor and flush the transmission fluid see if it works. If not then I am fucked and need a new transmission or back to square one needing a vehicle again. I hate life. I am just so depressed it's like there is always something with me. I know everyone deals with something, but my life has always been like this. Are we in a video game, a simulation where I am just a character constantly getting fucked over? I don't know. I am tired. I am stripped of my strength and faithless. The only good I ever got was when you all helped me leave my lying husband. I want to hide and disappear. I wish I had a husband who never put me in this situation where I needed to escape him and I wish I had a husband look after my choice in car to buy so I wouldn't get screwed. But it was all perfect on paper. Good things are always too good to be true. Sorry, no sexy image from me today. Just me screaming and crying AGAIN. I know you get what you pay for but I don't have 10k plus to pull out of my ass for a new car. I just can't stop crying and being angry. I try so hard to keep going but I am losing my strength... Have a nice weekend everyone.

item.title: learning about 9/11 in the middle of the ocean
item.description: From August to October of 2001, 55 people set sail as part of a BBC documentary/experiment "The Ship: Retracing Cook's Endeavour Voyage" in which they lived and worked as 18th century sailors as they travelled from Cairns to Jakarta. Captained by Chris Terrill aboard a replica of James Cook's HM Bark Endeavour, they navigated using old timey methods and had no contact with the outside world, unless the situation was dire. The captain broke protocol to deliver the news, and for the crew their only frame of reference for the event was his verbal description. They had no access to the visuals and media that 1/ 3 of the world accessed that day. Grief and an isolated shock was felt, but without the continuous stream of news terror, they eventually got back to their way of living. The option was offered to leave but not a single crew member opted for this. Episode 4: "Time Travelers" aired September 10, 2002. less
